# gitea_repositories (Data Source)

Lists repositories owned by a Gitea user or organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repositories" "example" {
  username = "my-org"
}
```
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Owner whose repositories to list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `repositories` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))
